payload.description_html: From source: Hybodontiformes teeth from the Akkermanovka locality in the Orenburg Oblast, Russia. (A-I) Meristodonoides sp.: (A-C) MMO № 12260/333, (A) labial view, (B) basal view, (C) lingual view; (D-E) MMO № 12260/342, (D) labial view, (E) lingual view; (F-G) MMO № 12260/339, (F) labial view, (G) lingual view; (H-I) MMO № 12260/340, (H) labial view, (I) lingual view. (J-N) cf. Polyacrodus sp.: (J-L) MMO № 12260/335, anterior tooth, (J) labial view, (K) occlusal view, (L) lingual view; (M-N) MMO № 12260/334, lateral tooth, (M) labial view, (N) occlusal view. Scale bars = 5 mm.
